title: Tensor saturation for even spin groups
main_claim: Kapovich–Millson saturation holds for Spin(2n), n>=2. If lambda+mu+nu lies in the root lattice Q(D_n), then (V(Nlambda) ⊗ V(Nmu) ⊗ V(Nnu))^G ≠ 0 for some positive integer N implies (V(lambda) ⊗ V(mu) ⊗ V(nu))^G ≠ 0. The proof has four steps: a real moment solution, then a real schedule whose switch roots form a basis, then an integral schedule via a half-relation deformation plus a strict comparison count, then a tensor intertwiner via fundamental columns. A preprojective doubling reduces the case where all three labels have a common zero tail.
